'''Durmat''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and was the son of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Rylon (spy)|Rylon]].

==Biography==
{{GameDS}}
In [[3643 BBY]], Durmat was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] when [[Rylon (spy)|his father]] was secretly helping the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]. While in captivity, he impulsively confessed about his father's true allegiance. He later encountered [[Darth Baras]]' [[Emperor's Wrath|apprentice]] who was sent to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. Durmat begged the [[Sith Warrior]] to spare him since he was valuable to the Empire, but the Warrior refused his offer and killed him.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Warrior has either the option of killing Durmat (Dark Side) or giving him a [[Spice/Legends|drug]] that would completely [[Amnesia/Legends|wipe his memory]] (Light Side). After taking the drug, the Warrior could kill Durmat anyway (Dark Side) or let him live (Light Side).
